item.title: Iraq sentences eight French nationals to life for joining Islamic State
item.description: An Iraqi court sentenced eight French nationals to life in prison on Thursday for joining the Islamic State (IS) group, as the country presses ahead with prosecuting thousands of suspected jihadists. Another two French defendants were sentenced to 15-year terms on similar charges, while 10 people who were supposed to receive verdicts had those postponed to another date. IS swept across Syria and Iraq in 2014, committing massacres and forcing women and girls into sexual slavery, while many... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: From volume to value: making tourism work for more of Europe
item.description: Tourism deserves a central place in European policymaking, writes Peter Lochbihler of Booking.com in an opinion piece for Euronews. The EU should support lesser-known destinations in attracting visitors worldwide, fostering local revitalisation, growth and prosperity. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Los Angeles landfill gas release: County declares emergency eight days after plume of gas, debris sent six to hospital
item.description: Los Angeles County has taken urgent action by declaring a local emergency following a notable gas release from Chiquita Canyon Landfill. The incident not only prompted the evacuation of local residents but also led to six individuals being hospitalized with minor injuries. Authorities are worried about the potential for additional hazardous releases and have sought state help. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: EU leaders braced for clashes over Ukraine aid at budget talks
item.description: Slovakia, Hungary and Czechia want to opt out of €45bn Ukraine loan to fill funding black hole caused by Russia’s relentless attacks Europe live – latest updates EU leaders are bracing for a clash over long-term financial aid for Ukraine, amid an effort to finalise high-stakes budget talks by the end of the year. Arriving in Brussels on Thursday, the German chancellor, Friedrich Merz, reiterated his view that all EU member states should support a €45bn (£38bn) loan for Ukraine for 2027. “When the European Union provides funding, it does so as the European Union – and that union consists of 27… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: French woman on trial for IS group propaganda tells court she’s ‘ashamed’
item.description: The trial of Émilie König, one of France's most high-profile Islamic State (IS) group recruits, opened in a Paris court on Thursday with the 41-year-old mother of five apologising to her children, mother and the "French nation" for her actions. König travelled in 2012 to Syria, where she appeared in the jihadist group's propaganda videos. She was repatriated to France in 2022. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Aerial footage shows diesel tanker sinking off Ibiza
item.description: A tanker carrying around 7,000 tonnes of diesel has capsized off Ibiza, prompting Spanish authorities to assess the risk of marine pollution. One crew member died after all 17 people on board were rescued. Fuente: Euronews.

El bloque, además, discute los presupuestos plurianuales del 2028-2034. Informe de nuestra corresponsal, Esther Herrera. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Season's eatings! Celebrating Thanksgiving in France
item.description: This Thursday marks Thanksgiving in the United States, the biggest travel holiday of the year there and arguably the most important on US calendars. But here in France, it's just another day. However, Americans living in Paris do try to capture the Thanksgiving spirit, though it can be tricky to track down the turkeys and pies required. Joining us to discuss how Americans do Thanksgiving in Paris is Cordon Bleu-trained chef and the owner of Boneshaker Donuts, Amanda Bankert. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Charli James

item.title: Florida man gets fresh chance to challenge copies of dead woman's will after originals go missing
item.description: Herman Levy is contesting the validity of a will and its codicil, both reportedly lost. A ruling from a Florida appeals court has affirmed Levy's right to pursue his case, enabling him to claim his status as the sole legal heir of Renee Paris in accordance with Florida law. The matter will revert to the lower court for an evaluation regarding the missing documents, potentially impacting the estate's allocation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Yemen: Calling for Collective Action and Resource Mobilization to Scale Up the Urgent Humanitarian Response
item.description: Country: Yemen Source: Life for Relief and Development 369,000 internally displaced people need essential humanitarian assistance to survive. Taiz and Lahj are among the leading governorates of origin for displaced families, requiring intensified relief efforts. Women and children are among the groups most severely affected by the conflict. Internal displacement continues across Yemen amid the escalating consequences of the conflict and mounting humanitarian pressures on affected families. According to the International Organization for Migration (IOM) Yemen report released this month… Fuente: ReliefWeb - Emergencias.

item.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon used his service weapon to murder two men. Did NSW police recruiters miss any red flags?
item.description: Video of convicted double murderer shows him in 2020 deploying a Taser at close range to an Indigenous man’s face, chest and neck Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon, the double murderer who killed Jesse Baird and Luke Davies while he was a serving New South Wales police officer, had been under review by the force for repeatedly using his Taser on a man four years before the killings. On Wednesday, he was convicted after a 12-person jury found he had murdered both men with his police service weapon on 19 February 2024. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Kansas man loses appeal over $369,346 divorce payment to ex-wife, wins reversal of grandparent visitation order
item.description: A Kansas man appealed a divorce settlement requiring him to pay his ex-wife $369,346. The court upheld the financial settlement but reversed an order granting visitation rights to the children's grandparents. The man argued that certain inherited funds should not be included in marital assets. The appeals court found that the lower court failed to follow the required legal procedures for grandparent visitation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Madagascar's near-total abortion ban puts women's lives at risk
item.description: November 25 marked the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. Activists argue that tackling gender-based violence also means addressing the wider inequalities that put women at risk, including restrictions on reproductive rights. In Madagascar, abortion is almost entirely banned, even in cases of rape, incest or when a woman's life is at risk. FRANCE 24’s Aurélie Kouman reports on the consequences of the country's strict laws, which force thousands of women to seek unsafe, clandestine procedures. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Moscow drone incursions: Poland to create no-fly zone at Ukraine border
item.description: Poland will soon create a no-fly zone near the Ukrainian border, a deputy defence minister announced on Wednesday, after several incursions into its airspace it blamed on Russia. Poland backs Ukraine as it fights off Russia's near five-year invasion and has repeatedly accused Moscow of seeking to target Kyiv's supporters with drone incursions and other methods. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Émilie König, 'the muse of the Islamic State group' goes on trial in France
item.description: French anti-terrorism prosecutors once dubbed her "the muse of the Islamic State group". On Thursday, Émilie König appears before a special criminal court in Paris, seeking to convince judges that she has been deradicalised. Originally from western France, König spent a decade in Syria and is accused of being one of the Islamic State group's most active French propagandists. Charged with criminal association with a terrorist organisation, she maintains that she has no blood on her hands. Fuente: France 24 - English.

La decisión rechaza el recurso presentado por la defensa para evitar el proceso, aunque limita la acusación a los hechos denunciados el 7 de agosto y descarta los correspondientes al día 13 del mismo mes. item.title: Australian court blocks plan to turn former coal power station into biomass plant that could power 200,000 homes
item.description: A court ruling in New South Wales upheld the denial of a biomass facility proposed by Verdant Earth Technologies. The project aimed to convert a coal-fired power station into a bioenergy hub, supplying electricity to 200,000 homes. Environmental groups opposed the project, fearing increased native vegetation clearing for fuel. Verdant Earth expressed surprise at the ruling and plans to consult its legal team for next steps. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: The Commonwealth Court has stepped in, imposing a temporary pause on Forsythe Farm's demolition while an appeal is considered. To prolong this halt, Save Forsythe Farm must secure $25,000 by November 30. Currently, they've garnered over $7,000 via a GoFundMe campaign aiming for $35,000. Due to safety concerns and the building's decline, West Goshen Township sought legal action. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Archaeologists digging ahead of an electricity substation found more than 200 Celtic coins
item.description: In Hungary, the discovery of over 200 Celtic silver coins during excavations for a new electricity substation is creating quite a buzz. These coins, which date back more than 2,000 years, are a remarkable testament to the region's ancient history. Additionally, the site revealed a Roman villa and prehistoric tools, showcasing thousands of years of human activity. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Louisiana father’s decision to give farm to brother upheld after children challenge inheritance
item.description: In Louisiana, a father's decision to transfer property to his brother, while retaining a lifetime residency right, sparked a legal battle after his death. His children contested the transfer, alleging it undermined their inheritance rights. However, the court found a lack of proof regarding inadequate living resources. The appeals court upheld the transfer, affirming the father's legal rights and the validity of his gift to his brother. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UK net migration falls to 77,000, lowest annual level in nearly 30 years
item.description: Net migration to the UK fell to 77,000 for the year to June, the lowest annual figure since 1997 excluding the Covid years, statistics showed on Thursday. The net migration figures – the difference between the numbers of people arriving in and leaving Britain – are a boost for the UK’s centre-left Labour government, which has been under pressure from the hard right anti-immigration Reform UK party on the issue. However, some economists have questioned whether low net migration is compatible with... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: Then ambassador to US wanted to discuss alternatives to World Trade Organization in ‘under the radar’ meeting, documents reveal UK politics live – latest updates Peter Mandelson sought to organise an “under the radar” meeting between an economic adviser to Donald Trump and a member of his former lobbying firm, Global Counsel, while he still held shares in the company, newly released documents reveal. In April 2025, while ambassador to Washington, Mandelson wanted to hold a lunch to discuss “alternative options” to the World Trade Organization and on how “like-minded partners come to terms… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
